profile.headline: Detail oriented iOS Developer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Deconstructing and reassembling electronic toys trying to figure out how they worked was one of my favorite pastimes as a child. Technology has always fascinated me, and I reminisce about the excitement of building my first custom desktop computer, creating my first webpage, and coding my first program. Since then, I have been following my passion to build technology that has a positive impact on people. Along the way, I have gained valuable experience by:

• Leveraging web technologies across the full stack to improve an e-commerce website that helps millions of small businesses market themselves.

• Collaborating with designers, developers, product managers, marketers, and manufacturing engineers across three different continents to launch products all over the world.

• Shipping new features in a dynamic, fast paced, agile environment with short sprint cycles and daily deployment to production.

I'm interested in building high impact native iOS applications with pixel perfect user interfaces that offer an intuitive and enjoyable user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built major mobile-first feature: Global Search, which dramatically improved our user experience by reducing the number of taps and amount of time needed to accomplish various tasks.
• Took ownership of the internationalization project to support different languages.
• Increased customer delight and loyalty by listening to their feedback and quickly fixing pain points.
• Led development efforts on many successful features that increased customer engagement including a new Dashboard, Custom Alerts, Reminders, a Welcome Flow for new users, etc.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
• Proposed and spearheaded a continuous integration initiative that alerts the team of build errors, warnings, static analysis issues, and unit test failures immediately. As a result, the iOS project went from 23 warnings and 18 issues to 0.

• Built and taken ownership of the entire customer section of the iPhone / iPad application. Functionality includes creating new customers, searching for customers, displaying a customer profile with their photos, appointment and order history, notes, preferences, and contact information.

• Designed and implemented functionality such as viewing credit card signatures and payments applied to an order, accepting custom payment methods, supporting local notifications, and various calendar enhancements.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Product Team
positions.description:
•  Improved efficiency for marketers and developers by enabling marketing tools to perform pricing management tasks that previously required a developer to execute, thus eliminating wait times of several days. This was done by designing and building a new API to manage product pricing data.

•  Increased productivity for developers by designing and building an extension to a web application with an intuitive drag and drop user interface to simplify the process of configuring products. Saved time by reducing this task from minutes to seconds.

•  Facilitated successful launch of first major core product overhaul into the Asian-Pacific market by leading and coordinating development with clients in Australia as the project architect. Quickly adapted to resolve a large increase in project scope caused by a late requirement change and enabled project to launch on time resulting in 166% annual revenue growth.

•  Enhanced clarity, flexibility, and maintainability of highly critical component of code base by completely rewriting it, modifying existing database tables, and creating new tables. Roughly 80,000 customer orders per day are affected by this code.

•  Improved quality of code base and database by deleting unnecessary code, refactoring legacy code, and dropping extraneous database tables, columns, and stored procedures.

•  Recruited talented developers and promoted the company with campus recruiting staff by serving as an alumni ambassador and attending MIT career fairs annually. Also served as a development mentor to two new developers and helped them integrate successfully into the development team and environment.

positions.title: Intern, Educational Technology Division
positions.description:
•  Implemented components of program for profiling a real-time operating system using C.
•  Wrote software specification for analysis tools that processed profiling data.
•  Created hex parsing utility program to convert sampling data to bar graph display.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant, Responsive Environments Group
positions.description:
•  Researched methods to interface an online virtual world, called Second Life, with the real world.
•  Created process to convert text from Second Life into speech.
•  Performed audio processing to mix and combine speech samples using Python.

positions.title: Intern, Aerospace Electronics and Information Technology
positions.description:
•  Built parsing program to extract military aircraft flight data from military file format using C.
•  Created tool to compute ballistics calculations in multiple coordinate systems.
•  Contributed to modeling an autopilot system in terms of its fundamental components, inputs, and outputs.
